_rleite21_: Nils Rleite reported to W-F17 with a rosary of rough beads sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.

Nils praised a private by name in front of the whole line. The private went red and stood a little taller for a week. The letter for Nils ended with 'come home soon'. Nils read the last line more than the rest.
danxdoody: Dietrich Danxdoody joined the replacements on Day 10. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.

Henrik "Smokes" Simohayha (Hegemony) and Dietrich Danxdoody (Concord) spotted the same abandoned cart near Calvary Farm. A long exchange of shots left the cart exactly where it was. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Dietrich Danxdoody wrote to a fiancée who wears his ring on a chain that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

The trench wall shook against Dietrich Danxdoody's shoulder during the bombardment. He pressed both feet into the boards and waited for the next hit. A letter from home found Dietrich Danxdoody before the night shift. Dietrich Danxdoody folded it small and kept it close. Now serving as a stretcher bearer, Dietrich Danxdoody discovered that being experienced at the front did not prevent being new at the job.
Anselm Ofsoup held the mirror while Dietrich Danxdoody shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.

Wiring party. Dietrich Danxdoody held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at U-F20, and everyone came back. A letter from home found Dietrich Danxdoody before the night shift. Dietrich Danxdoody folded it small and kept it close.

Henrik "Saint" Rlhaight of the Hegemony shouted across the wire at Verdel Ridge, asking for the football scores from home. Dietrich Danxdoody of the Concord shouted them back. Some of them were even true. A letter from home found Dietrich Danxdoody before the night shift. Dietrich Danxdoody folded it small and kept it close.

Teodor "Parson" Kobakk gave Dietrich Danxdoody the last match in the trench. Dietrich used it to light a candle so that Parson could finish a letter. A letter for Dietrich Danxdoody said the whole street was asking about the front. Dietrich Danxdoody did not know where to begin the answer.

Dietrich Danxdoody watched fog gather on the wire until every strand carried beads of water. The sentry beside him called it expensive fencing. The letter for Dietrich Danxdoody was written in pencil, with a lot of crossing out. Dietrich Danxdoody liked the crossed-out parts best.

Dietrich and Jonas Ofsoup divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion. There was a parcel for Dietrich: socks, a cake, and a note that said eat the cake first. Dietrich ate the cake first.
erikvukk: Konrad Erikvukk came from Oakmere, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
Konrad Erikvukk answered the first call, number 37 on the rolls. Somebody chalked the number on his helmet. It has not washed off yet.
The new duty roster listed Konrad Erikvukk as a stretcher bearer. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down.
Verdel Ridge has been won. Konrad Erikvukk listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Konrad Erikvukk splinted a broken leg with a rifle and two belts. The patient asked if he was a real doctor. He said yes. He was lying.
At Saint-Ash crossroads, Konrad Erikvukk of the Concord and Felix "Parson" Brendanm of the Hegemony spent the morning shooting at the same loose sheet of metal. The sheet kept winning.

Asked what he will do after the war, Konrad Erikvukk said: 'Be a farmhand in Oakmere. And never complain about anything, ever again.' The Hegemony won Hill 304. In R-F13, Konrad Erikvukk listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Rain all night. Konrad Erikvukk bailed water out of R-F13 with a helmet until his hands stopped feeling anything.
Rumour reached R-F13 that the war would be over by spring. Konrad Erikvukk has heard it before. So has everyone.
Konrad Erikvukk agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age.
A story about a goat passed through three dugouts and reached Konrad Erikvukk as a story about a general. The ending was the same.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Konrad Erikvukk was hit hard in the fight at R-F13 before anyone could fire. The raider was Severin Summer of the Hegemony. Raider: Severin Summer of the Hegemony (@summer.l_21). Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Konrad Erikvukk wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

A bullet went into Konrad Erikvukk's chest just under the heart at R-F13. The medic said not to give him water, and then said nothing more. Shot by Marek Berkaatilla of the Hegemony (@berkaatilla). Konrad Erikvukk was killed at R-F13 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Marek Berkaatilla of the Hegemony (@berkaatilla).

Anselm Erikvukk took the same post at R-F13 where Konrad Erikvukk stood. He found his cousin's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them. Volunteer number 37. The quartermaster pinned the First Wave ribbon on Anselm Erikvukk's tunic and said: 'Don't let the mud have it.' Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Anselm Erikvukk kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
Anselm Erikvukk mended the hole in Viktor Detroit's trousers with fishing line and a bent pin. Viktor says the patch is stronger than the trousers.
Someone in R-F13 asked Anselm Erikvukk about Oakmere. He talked for an hour. Nobody interrupted.
A replacement turned out to be from Oakmere too. Anselm Erikvukk and the newcomer argued about the same bakery for half the night.

Anselm Erikvukk took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at R-F13, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Tobias Deadeyesimul of the Hegemony (@deadeyesimulacrum). Anselm Erikvukk was killed at R-F13 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Tobias Deadeyesimul of the Hegemony (@deadeyesimulacrum).
The papers say Jakub Erikvukk. The sergeant says he has his uncle's eyes. Anselm Erikvukk's eyes. Nobody in R-F13 argues.
A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at R-F13. Jakub Erikvukk was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Konrad Sebs of the Hegemony (@_sebs.c_).
Dorian Erikvukk had heard about Jakub Erikvukk's courage. At R-F13, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

Machine-gun fire swept R-F13. Dorian Erikvukk took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Leopold Kapitancray of the Hegemony (@kapitancray). Dorian Erikvukk looked over the parapet at R-F13 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Leopold Kapitancray of the Hegemony (@kapitancray).
The House of Erikvukk sent Valentin Erikvukk after Dorian Erikvukk. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
A borrowed towel came back cleaner than when Valentin lent it. He is considering lending out the rest of the washing.
felix.kfg: The draft reached R-F20 on Day 4. Benedikt Kfg was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.
Dawn watch. Benedikt Kfg put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Arno "Doc" Jameson, gravely wounded.

Benedikt Kfg was promoted to Lance Corporal. The first request addressed to the new rank concerned a blocked drain. On Day 6, Hill 304 passed to the Hegemony. Benedikt Kfg wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Benedikt Kfg had a letter from home. He read it four times and then once more out loud, for the men who never get any.
Benedikt Kfg fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Jakub Nistico, gravely wounded. Nobody nearby said anything.

Benedikt Kfg waited for someone in the enemy trench to lift a pair of field glasses. Florian "Lucky" Nistico did, and was grazed. Benedikt Kfg was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at R-F20. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Gideon "Ghost" Marks of the Concord (@marks89kk).
A medic stopped by Benedikt Kfg's stretcher every few hours for a week. Today the medic found it empty. Benedikt Kfg had gone back to R-F20.
Benedikt Kfg was on watch at R-F20 when the night raid hit. The men found Benedikt Kfg at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Ivo "Tin" Chappell of the Concord (@cooper_chappell22).
Another member of the House of Kfg reached the line: Hugo "Mole" Kfg. He asked where Benedikt Kfg had slept, then chose a different corner.

On dawn watch at R-F20, Hugo "Mole" Kfg fired at a shadow by the enemy wire. The shadow was Marek Marks, now badly wounded. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Hugo "Mole" Kfg is number 248. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Hugo "Mole" Kfg helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
New laces made Hugo "Mole" Kfg's boots look almost respectable, until he stood up.
On a quiet night Hugo "Mole" Kfg (Hegemony) and Benedikt "Mole" Olliedav (Concord) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there.
Hugo "Mole" Kfg drew the street leading to Coldwater. There was no room left for the last house, so he turned the page over.
Yann Upra of the Concord threw a tin of tobacco into the Hegemony trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Hugo "Mole" Kfg kept the tin.
Hugo "Mole" Kfg and Marek Berkaatilla carried a kettle through three narrow turns without spilling a drop. The applause at the end caused the accident.
Hugo "Mole" Kfg found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'.
Hugo found a bent fork in the mud and polished it for an hour. He now owns the best fork in the squad.
hyniiiis: In Old Harrow, Roland Hyniiiis was a farmhand. In T-F10, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a farmhand again.

A bullet went through Roland Hyniiiis's upper arm at T-F10 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Yann Argall of the Concord (@james_argall_05). Roland Hyniiiis was killed outright at T-F10, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Yann Argall of the Concord (@james_argall_05).
A letter came with Casimir Hyniiiis: "I am Roland Hyniiiis's brother. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.

Casimir Hyniiiis had kept the gun aimed at the enemy supply path for days. Tonight the supply party came, and Dorian Castle was grazed. Casimir Hyniiiis felt a hard tug at his hip at T-F10. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Bastian Tartochuk of the Concord (@tartochuk). The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Casimir Hyniiiis did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

Casimir Hyniiiis no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt. A letter from home found Casimir Hyniiiis before the night shift. Casimir Hyniiiis folded it small and kept it close.

Casimir Hyniiiis was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at T-F10. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Bastian Tartochuk of the Concord (@tartochuk).
Casimir Hyniiiis stopped talking around midday. The medic took one look and called for a stretcher.
Casimir Hyniiiis spent a week on a stretcher in the corridor of the aid post. Today he stood up, held the wall, and walked out to T-F10.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Casimir Hyniiiis was hit hard in the fight at T-F10 before anyone could fire. The raider was Roland Dr of the Concord. Raider: Roland Dr of the Concord (@dr8427932). Casimir Hyniiiis kept the new letter in a breast pocket all day, and touched the pocket now and then to check it was there.

A round came through the loophole Casimir Hyniiiis was watching at T-F10 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Nils Azhanselmc of the Concord (@azhanselmc). Casimir Hyniiiis spent the night on a stretcher in the trench behind the aid post. Every bed was taken.

Casimir survived the wound and the waiting. He is back at T-F10, and still will not talk about the nights outside the aid post. The mail bag had a letter for Casimir and nothing for anyone else. Casimir read it as quietly as he could. The new duty roster listed Casimir as a signaller. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down.
idkdunnoman: The draft reached R-S9 on Day 5. Edmund "Shadow" Idkdunnoman was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.

Edmund "Shadow" Idkdunnoman began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Edmund "Shadow" Idkdunnoman helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Edmund "Shadow" Idkdunnoman sorted the dressings by lamplight. When the next stretcher arrived, he could find everything without looking.
Edmund "Shadow" Idkdunnoman carved his initials into the trench wall next to a hundred others. Some of them are only half finished.
Word of Edmund "Shadow" Idkdunnoman's blanket spread. A strip of lining and a square from an old scarf arrived without explanation.
A man asked Edmund "Shadow" Idkdunnoman to describe Oakmere without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch.

A bullet grazed Edmund "Shadow" Idkdunnoman's ribs at R-S9. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Arno "Lucky" Yokley of the Concord (@brock_yokley). Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Edmund "Shadow" Idkdunnoman shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Three days with a bandage, and Edmund "Shadow" Idkdunnoman is back at R-S9. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Edmund "Shadow" Idkdunnoman answered to number 338. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Edmund "Shadow" Idkdunnoman folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Edmund "Shadow" Idkdunnoman finished the blanket using six kinds of cloth. The men can identify most of the donors by the patches alone.
The patched blanket kept Edmund "Shadow" Idkdunnoman warm through the night. In the morning, a neighbour arrived with another torn blanket and an optimistic expression.
Edmund "Shadow" Idkdunnoman sang under his breath on sentry. Across the wire, very quietly, somebody sang the next line.
Edmund "Shadow" Idkdunnoman cut Nils Amourika's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short.

Machine-gun fire swept R-S9. Edmund "Shadow" Idkdunnoman took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Otto "Lucky" Guy of the Concord (@jurassic_guy013). There was no bed for Edmund "Shadow" Idkdunnoman. He lay on a stretcher outside, wrapped in a coat, listening to the guns.
Every bed was taken and every medic was busy. Edmund "Shadow" Idkdunnoman died waiting. The men at R-S9 have not stopped talking about it.
Walter Idkdunnoman put his brother's pocket watch beside the bunk. Someone who had known Edmund "Shadow" Idkdunnoman helped clear the shelf without saying why.
Walter of the Hegemony spotted Cyril Raptor of the Concord repairing a parapet at Verdel Ridge. A warning shot stopped the repair on the spot.
j0seph_r0gers: Day 9: Wendel Gers reached S-R7 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
Victory at Blackwater Canal. Wendel Gers let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

The gun crews at S-R7 and the next post fired together on a count of five. Caught between the two guns, Norbert Slc was grazed. Wendel Gers had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Jonas Lynxxactual was badly wounded. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Wendel Gers did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Wendel Gers spent the evening teaching a recruit to sew. The recruit pricked a finger and accused the needle of taking sides.
The water jacket hissed as Wendel Gers fired across no man's land. When the gun went quiet, Valentin Thorholting was grazed.

Wendel Gers went out with the wiring party at S-R7. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit. Wendel Gers had marked the corner of the enemy trench with two stakes in daylight. At night the gun fired between the stakes, blind. Jakub "Mole" Xman was grazed.

Wendel Gers fired short bursts at the gap in the enemy wire, the way the sergeant taught. Hugo "Owl" Guy was grazed trying to cross it. Wendel Gers took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at S-R7, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Tobias Connordavids of the Concord (@connordavidscott). Wendel Gers looked over the parapet at S-R7 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Tobias Connordavids of the Concord (@connordavidscott).
Walter "Spark" Gers asked about Wendel Gers on arriving at S-R7. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.

The raid hit the Concord line at the darkest hour. Walter "Spark" Gers fought Edmund "Hollow" Biwott in a trench no wider than a door. Walter "Spark" Gers came home with Edmund "Hollow" Biwott's cap badge. (@a_k_biwott) On the way back from the night raid a flare went up. Walter "Spark" Gers was caught in the open and hit before reaching the wire.
Fever took hold of Walter "Spark" Gers overnight. The medics changed the dressing twice and then called for the bearers.
Walter is back from the field hospital, thinner and quieter, with a pressed cornflower still in his pocket.
kellen_mcplate: Cyril "Hollow" Mcplate walked into R-S7 on Day 6 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
An empty jam tin became Cyril "Hollow" Mcplate's cup. The first drink still tasted of strawberries. He took small sips.
Cyril "Hollow" Mcplate got a letter from Marguerite. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most.
Cyril "Hollow" Mcplate wrote back to Marguerite and tore it up three times. The fourth version says almost nothing, which is how he knows it is the right one.
Cyril "Hollow" Mcplate carried Felix "Tin" Euberitamini's rifle all the way up to the Ossuary Wood after Tin twisted an ankle. Neither has said thank you. Neither needs to.
Blackwater Canal has been won. Cyril "Hollow" Mcplate listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

No post for Cyril "Hollow" Mcplate this week. He checks the sack anyway, every day, and pretends he was only looking for tobacco. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Cyril "Hollow" Mcplate is number 400. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Cyril "Hollow" Mcplate during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

Cyril "Hollow" Mcplate felt a hard tug at his hip at R-S7. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Lucien Carlson of the Concord (@nicholas_carlson).

Cyril "Hollow" Mcplate was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at R-S7. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Rafael Real of the Concord (@colt2real). Cyril "Hollow" Mcplate was killed at R-S7 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Rafael Real of the Concord (@colt2real).
A letter came with Albin Mcplate: "I am Cyril "Hollow" Mcplate's older brother. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
Albin Mcplate was hit in the hip at R-S7. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Rafael Real of the Concord (@colt2real).
The bearers moved Albin Mcplate's stretcher against the wall at midday and back again at dusk. That was the whole schedule.
Albin Mcplate returned to R-S7 thinner and paler, with a wound that closed without a single night in a bed. The medics count it as one of theirs.
Felix "Tin" Euberitamini and Albin Mcplate both swear they saw a ghost at Grey Mill. Each says the other screamed first.
Albin rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Emil "Rabbit" Hill was grazed at the far edge of no man's land.
lei.shi04: Marek Shi found a place in R-S5 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
Marek Shi wrote letters for men who could not write, and some for men who could but did not know the words.
A man asked Marek Shi to sit nearby without saying anything. He stayed until the man fell asleep. A letter from home reached Marek Shi before dusk. Marek Shi read it twice and slept a little easier.

Marek Shi held a service beside a ration store. The men sang quietly so the sleepers behind the wall could rest. A letter from home reached Marek Shi before dusk. Marek Shi read it twice and slept a little easier.
On Day 10, Blackwater Canal passed to the Hegemony. Marek Shi wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

Marek Shi hummed an old song from home on sentry. From the other side of the wire, very faintly, someone hummed it back. The clerk counted the names twice. Marek Shi is number 437 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Marek Shi did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Marek Shi kept watch so that Otto Tyner could sleep. Then Otto kept watch so that Marek could. Neither slept.
Marek Shi sang the first verse tonight, out loud. The other side sang the second. Nobody fired for an hour.
Marek Shi washed his face and someone asked if headquarters was visiting. Apparently being clean needs an explanation.
Marek Shi drew the street leading to Northwick. There was no room left for the last house, so he turned the page over.
An officer heard about the singing and forbade it. Tonight Marek Shi only whistled the first bar. Across the wire, someone whistled the last.
Marek Shi was asked to arrange a gathering for men who did not want a sermon. He asked what they did want and wrote down the answers.
The list for Marek's gathering contains a poem, a song and a request for five minutes without orders. All three seem possible.
leowilliams22507: On Day 9, Valentin "Shadow" Leowilliams arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.

Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Valentin "Shadow" Leowilliams could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable. Mail came up the line with a letter for Valentin "Shadow" Leowilliams. Valentin "Shadow" Leowilliams read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Valentin "Shadow" Leowilliams counted the stitches in a darned sock while waiting for orders. Whoever fixed it had used three colors of wool. Mail came up the line with a letter for Valentin "Shadow" Leowilliams. Valentin "Shadow" Leowilliams read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Valentin "Shadow" Leowilliams did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

Valentin "Shadow" Leowilliams spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again. Mail came up the line with a letter for Valentin "Shadow" Leowilliams. Valentin "Shadow" Leowilliams read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A dog crosses no man's land at the Bone Quarry every night, fed by Valentin "Shadow" Leowilliams on one side and Silas Shorlock on the other. The Hegemony call it Patrol. The Concord call it Spy. Mail came up the line with a letter for Valentin "Shadow" Leowilliams. Valentin "Shadow" Leowilliams read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Somebody hung a doorbell on the next dugout. Valentin "Shadow" Leowilliams went to look. It was a spoon tied to an empty tin. Mail came up the line with a letter for Valentin "Shadow" Leowilliams. Valentin "Shadow" Leowilliams read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Dawn watch. Valentin "Shadow" Leowilliams put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Roland "Mole" Tuckerdesave, grazed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Valentin "Shadow" Leowilliams. Valentin "Shadow" Leowilliams read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The whole squad at R-R17 fired five rounds rapid. The squad agrees it was Valentin "Shadow" Leowilliams's bullet that found Viktor "Crow" Daone, grazed. Valentin "Shadow" Leowilliams had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Dietrich Zaza was badly wounded. Valentin "Shadow" Leowilliams had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Bastian Christianbar was grazed. The mail bag came up with the soup. There was a letter for Valentin "Shadow" Leowilliams, and the soup went cold while Valentin "Shadow" Leowilliams read it.

Valentin "Shadow" Leowilliams fired at the muzzle flash across the wire before it faded. Viktor "Crow" Daone was badly wounded, and that rifle did not fire again tonight. Valentin "Shadow" Leowilliams got a letter today. The handwriting was shaky, but the news was good. The letter went inside the helmet, for luck.

Valentin found an old map of the Chalk Pits from before the war. There was a school on it, and an orchard. He looked for them. He did not find them. A letter for Valentin came with a pressed flower inside. Valentin showed the flower to nobody.
lewis_edwardss: On Day 10 Albin Edwardss took a post at T-F15 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He laughs at exactly the wrong moments, and the men liked him for it.

Albin Edwardss counted the stitches in a darned sock while waiting for orders. Whoever fixed it had used three colors of wool. A letter from home reached Albin Edwardss before dusk. Albin Edwardss read it twice and slept a little easier. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Albin Edwardss could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Somebody hung a doorbell on the next dugout. Albin Edwardss went to look. It was a spoon tied to an empty tin. A letter from home reached Albin Edwardss before dusk. Albin Edwardss read it twice and slept a little easier. Albin Edwardss bought War Bonds for the front. The quartermaster pinned the ribbon on personally: 'The front remembers who kept it fed.' Albin Edwardss was invited to the Officers' Mess for keeping the front supplied. The colonel poured a real coffee and raised his cup: 'The front does not forget its friends.' The quartermaster had a dachshund pup nobody wanted. Albin Edwardss took it and called it Holly. The whole squad already spoils it.

A flare lit the Brickworks like noon. Albin Edwardss counted the seconds until darkness: eleven. A letter from home reached Albin Edwardss before dusk. Albin Edwardss read it twice and slept a little easier.

Albin Edwardss spent the night in no man's land with pliers and a roll of wire. Every flare meant lying flat in the mud. The gap at T-F15 is closed now. Albin Edwardss reached up to fix a sandbag at T-F15 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Karel Smolders of the Concord (@arno.smolders). A letter from home reached Albin Edwardss before dusk. Albin Edwardss read it twice and slept a little easier.

A bullet found Albin Edwardss at T-F15, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Dorian "Owl" Enclavecorey of the Concord (@enclavecorey05). A letter from home reached Albin Edwardss before dusk. Albin Edwardss read it twice and slept a little easier.

A medic brought Albin Edwardss half a cup of soup and a promise. The soup was real. The letter for Albin Edwardss was written in pencil, with a lot of crossing out. Albin Edwardss liked the crossed-out parts best.

The stretcher Albin Edwardss lay on for so long has a dent the shape of a body. Albin Edwardss is back at T-F15, and someone else is lying in that dent now. The runner said a letter for Albin Edwardss had come up with the ammunition. Albin Edwardss went to get it before the ammunition.

On a quiet night Albin (Hegemony) and Henrik "Rabbit" Lewis (Concord) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there. A letter came for Albin from the man who owns the shop back home. It said Albin's job would be waiting. Albin read that line to the squad.
mac_a_millii: The new rifleman is Norbert "Crow" Millii, once a lamplighter from Saint-Lune. The corporal asked if a lamplighter was any use in a trench. Norbert "Crow" Millii said he would find out. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Norbert "Crow" Millii during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Norbert "Crow" Millii and Jakub Patrickktz carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle.
Norbert "Crow" Millii had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Gideon "Rabbit" Lacy crossed it, Norbert "Crow" Millii fired. Gideon "Rabbit" Lacy was badly wounded.
Norbert "Crow" Millii and Isidor "Doc" Slick compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.
A rat stole Norbert "Crow" Millii's cheese ration while he watched. He let it. The rat looked hungrier.

Twenty yards of mud, one gap in the wire, one jump. Norbert "Crow" Millii landed next to Leopold Daddy in the Concord trench. Only Norbert "Crow" Millii climbed back out. (@v_war_daddy_v) Back from the raid, Norbert "Crow" Millii found a sweetheart card in a coat pocket that was not there before: 'Seaside' (common). Nobody asked where it came from. The letter for Norbert "Crow" Millii had a few coins taped inside. They would buy almost nothing here, but Norbert "Crow" Millii kept them.
Fresh from training, Norbert "Crow" Millii still aims the way the instructor said. Today it worked: Ivo "Shadow" Lacy, gravely wounded.
Norbert's left boot has opened at the toe. He tied it with string and walked as if nothing had happened.
meefbince: Bastian "Saint" Meefbince joined the replacements on Day 15. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
Bastian "Saint" Meefbince was promised a surprise at supper. It was an extra potato. He accepted the surprise with proper ceremony.
A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Bastian "Saint" Meefbince gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page.
Bastian lost a boot in the trench. Felix Ryanstebbins found it, stuffed it with dry socks, and gave it back without a word.
mrpickypants_: The new machine gunner gave his name as Edmund "Parson" Mrpickypants. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
Edmund "Parson" Mrpickypants received the First Wave ribbon. He checked the stitching twice before putting the tunic back on.
Edmund "Parson" Mrpickypants walked the captured trenches of Verdel Ridge and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Edmund "Parson" Mrpickypants was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success.
Albin Zgz and Edmund "Parson" Mrpickypants compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.

The shelling stopped while Edmund "Parson" Mrpickypants was counting the seconds between hits. He kept counting anyway, and waited a long time before moving. The Hegemony hold Hill 304 now, and they can see straight into S-F14. Edmund "Parson" Mrpickypants has learned to walk bent double.
Edmund "Parson" Mrpickypants found water collecting beneath the gun's cover. He sketched a small shelter and took the drawing to the stores.
Promoted to Lance Corporal, Edmund "Parson" Mrpickypants had to settle an argument he had been happily taking part in five minutes earlier.

A bullet clipped Edmund "Parson" Mrpickypants's helmet at S-F14 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Quentin "Spark" Josiascouper of the Hegemony (@josiascouper).

A single shot from across the wire hit Edmund "Parson" Mrpickypants in the thigh at S-F14. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Felix Varsikasikra of the Hegemony (@varsikasikranaatti). Edmund "Parson" Mrpickypants was killed outright at S-F14, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Felix Varsikasikra of the Hegemony (@varsikasikranaatti).

The House of Mrpickypants sent another. Nils Mrpickypants, cousin of Edmund "Parson" Mrpickypants, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence. Volunteer number 97. The quartermaster pinned the First Wave ribbon on Nils Mrpickypants's tunic and said: 'Don't let the mud have it.'

Nils Mrpickypants was on the dawn watch at S-F14 when the Hegemony raiders came. A club, a shout, and Nils Mrpickypants was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Walter Mat of the Hegemony (@civo_mat). The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Nils Mrpickypants looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

Nils Mrpickypants was found at the bottom of the trench at S-F14, hit in the head, helmet split open. He is breathing in short, loud gasps. Shot by Isidor "Owl" Demirkeskin of the Hegemony (@demirkeskin06). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Nils Mrpickypants fell at S-F14 and never moved again. Shot by Isidor "Owl" Demirkeskin of the Hegemony (@demirkeskin06).

Hugo "Bones" Mrpickypants joined S-F14 under the shadow of Nils Mrpickypants's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one. First Wave. Hugo "Bones" Mrpickypants signed when the ink on the posters was still fresh. He keeps the ribbon wrapped in oilcloth with a book with the last pages torn out. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Hugo "Bones" Mrpickypants watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
A flare lit the Ossuary Wood like noon. Hugo "Bones" Mrpickypants counted the seconds until darkness: eleven.
Hugo "Bones" Mrpickypants raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-F14. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Otto Aegisdirecti of the Hegemony (@aegisdirectivee).
Hugo "Bones" Mrpickypants no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.

Hugo "Bones" Mrpickypants felt a hard tug at his hip at S-F14. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Jakub "Doc" Fxx of the Hegemony (@jamie_fxx1).

Hugo "Bones" Mrpickypants was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at S-F14. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Wendel "Hollow" Arthur of the Hegemony (@arthur.ds999).
The medics had to choose who got the last bed. They did not choose Hugo "Bones" Mrpickypants. He died on the stretcher before morning.
The papers say Teodor Mrpickypants. The sergeant says he has his father's eyes. Hugo "Bones" Mrpickypants's eyes. Nobody in S-F14 argues.
During a lull at Grey Mill, Teodor called across from the Concord line. Karel Miller answered from the Hegemony side with a perfect imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet.
nathan.kurtus: At the depot, Zeno "Parson" Kurtus had practised answering to his name. At M-F21, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
tanghulu_broccoli: Tobias "Mud" Broccoli arrived on Day 9 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Tobias "Mud" Broccoli in the open at S-R12. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Jonas "Ash" Tomar of the Hegemony (@agastya_singh_tomar_). Tobias "Mud" Broccoli stood up to fix a loose sandbag at S-R12. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Jonas "Ash" Tomar of the Hegemony (@agastya_singh_tomar_).
Valentin Broccoli joined S-R12 under the shadow of Tobias "Mud" Broccoli's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.

Valentin Broccoli was hit through the chest at S-R12. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Cyril Ofsmth of the Hegemony (@cantthink_ofsmth). Valentin Broccoli was killed outright at S-R12, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Cyril Ofsmth of the Hegemony (@cantthink_ofsmth).

The House of Broccoli sent Clement Broccoli after Valentin Broccoli. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks. Clement Broccoli got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 879. The men who came later will ask about it. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Clement Broccoli read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Clement Broccoli woke with his hair frozen to the sandbags. The cook brought tea so hot it hurt. Nobody complained.
Clement Broccoli counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Arno Yearslong was gravely wounded.

A bullet hit Clement Broccoli's belt buckle at S-R12 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Clement "Parson" Sterlinglanc of the Hegemony (@sterlinglance_).

Clement Broccoli was found at the bottom of the trench at S-R12, hit in the head, helmet split open. He is breathing in short, loud gasps. Shot by Otto Aegisdirecti of the Hegemony (@aegisdirectivee). Every bed was taken and every medic was busy. Clement Broccoli died waiting. The men at S-R12 have not stopped talking about it.
Arno Broccoli took the same post at S-R12 where Clement Broccoli stood. He found his uncle's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
In the rear quarters, Arno Broccoli played football against the sappers. The ball was a sandbag stuffed with straw. The sappers cheated.

A bullet hit Arno Broccoli in the neck at S-R12. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Shot by Ulrich "Lucky" Krokous of the Hegemony (@krokous21). Arno Broccoli asked the bearers for water and then for his mother. He died before either came.
Quentin "Brick" Broccoli had heard about Arno Broccoli's courage. At S-R12, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

Quentin was hit through the stomach at S-R12. The bearers ran with the stretcher and did not stop to rest. Shot by Anselm Nothing of the Hegemony (@emir.nothing). Quentin was killed at S-R12 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence.
Wendel Broccoli arrived carrying the family name of Quentin "Brick" Broccoli. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
